text:
```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  build-and-publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org/'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install --only=prod

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Publish to npm
        if: github.ref == 'refs/tags/v*'
        run: npm publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create GitHub release
        if: github.ref == 'refs/tags/v*'
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Post Twist announcement
        if: github.ref == 'refs/tags/v*'
        run: |
          curl -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"message": "A new version of todoist-cli has been released! 🚀"}' \
            https://api.twist.chat/messages
        env:
          TWIST_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.TWIST_API_KEY }}
```
